name: 2025_ward_results
title: Telangana 2025 gram panchayat ward members
description: One row per ward in the commission's 'G.P Ward Member' elected report (tsec.gov.in/knowPRRural). Covers the mandals TSEC published: 62,990 wards in 7,140 GPs. No women's reservation, winner sex or votes are printed.

fields.name: state
fields.description: State

fields.name: year
fields.description: Election year

fields.name: district
fields.description: District, as on the commission's form

fields.name: block
fields.description: Mandal, as on the commission's form

fields.name: gram_panchayat
fields.description: Gram panchayat, as printed in the report's caption

fields.name: ward_no
fields.description: Ward number from the report's ward name ('Ward 5' -> '5')

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Office, canonical

fields.name: tier_local
fields.description: Office as the state names it

fields.name: reserved_label
fields.description: Pooled reservation label; null: the report states no women's reservation, so caste and woman cannot be joined

fields.name: reserved_caste
fields.description: Caste category the ward is reserved for (UR -> NONE); null where the report prints '--'

fields.name: reserved_woman
fields.description: Whether the ward is reserved for a woman: null throughout, because the report's 'Reserved for' cell gives the caste category only

fields.name: reserved_raw
fields.description: 'Reserved for', as printed

fields.name: winner
fields.description: Name of the Elected Candidate, as printed; null where the report prints '--'

fields.name: winner_basis
fields.description: How the winner is known

fields.name: party
fields.description: Party: not printed in the ward report; null throughout

fields.name: unopposed
fields.description: 1 for 'Unanimous', 0 for 'Elected'; null where the report prints '--'

fields.name: script
fields.description: Script of the names

fields.name: district_id
fields.description: Commission's district code

fields.name: mandal_id
fields.description: Commission's mandal code

fields.name: gp_code
fields.description: Commission's GP code within the mandal, from the GP dropdown frame (matched on the folded name)

fields.name: result_status
fields.description: Result Status, as printed; null where '--'

fields.name: source_path
fields.description: Saved report page (stored gzipped as <path>.gz)

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Form the report was posted to

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Row on the saved page
